sources.title: Fine-tuning SmolVLA for Cube Pick-and-Place on SO-101
sources.snippet: SmolVLA is a 500M+ parameter model, but you only fine-tune ~50M (the action expert + projections). The vision encoder (SigLIP) and language model (SmolLM2) stay frozen.

sources.snippet: GitHub - zwaneiz/so101-vla-pickplace: Does a compact vision-language-action model actually follow its instruction, or just visual shortcuts? SmolVLA fine-tuned on a simulated SO-101 arm for a two-disc pick-and-place task where only the words identify the target.

sources.title: SmolVLA Fine-tuning for Robotic Manipulation - GitHub
sources.snippet: Research Project for HSE Robotics Laboratory This repository contains the implementation and results of fine-tuning the SmolVLA (Small Vision-Language-Action) model for robotic manipulation tasks using the LeRobot framework.
